description: Search INSIDE company-brain pages — their titles and their bodies. Use it to find where a fact already lives before writing it somewhere new; get_wiki_tree gives you every title, so reach for this when what you are looking for is in a page's contents rather than its name.

query.description: Words to look for. Words shorter than three characters are ignored.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: search_wiki
